message:
test(rel-0164): old-APK lane r7f -- SH requested off through 0.2.32's own Settings, a 30 s no-input watch after the first frame, a read-only record after every FAIL, and the candidate's server with the relay trace only

Codex codex_old_apk_lane_src_r7d.md (3) / verifier r7f, on 6345512 + 3f18465. Test lane only: no product file.

1 SH off (both arms, after install + pm clear, on the targets screen before the pick): listSettingsButton ->
  settingsSharpOffButton (b554e76 MainActivity.kt:531 / :5308 selectSharpness(OFF, "settings")). The control must be on
  screen (inside android:id/content) and enabled, else the arm is NOT RUN (INVALID) -- no prefs edit, no hidden handler.
  Judged (2s): the app's own sharpness_select level=off origin=settings and the button selected; the settings screen kept
  as a ui dump. At the picture (3s): sharpen_path path=direct requested=off, no sharpen path, sharpen_start 0, no
  fallback -- a weak request that fell back to effective=off is NOT SH off. oa_adb.dump also reads selected / password.
2 relay trace: 53fced4's apps/directory has no REMOTE60_RELAY_TRACE. oa_relay_trace_server.py builds a TEST COPY of the
  candidate's directory (53fced4 files, server.js sha256 2742143d...) + relay_trace/relay_trace_53fced4.diff = the
  reviewed 7a79b09 trace re-cut against 53fced4 (additions; three relay sends gain the trace's send callback, undefined
  when off) -> server.js 52918c04..., every hash pinned, applied exactly (no fuzz). check: 7a79b09's relay_trace_test
  passes whole on the copy (POSITIVE: real [relay-trace] flow lines); on 53fced4 as it is, with the variable set, "the
  trace says it is on" FAILs (NEGATIVE) while its relay works. The fixture: with KE_RELAY_TRACE=1 it needs -ServerSha256
  (the directory file must be the pinned one) and the directory's own '[relay-trace] ENABLED' within 8 s -- else no
  host, no AVD. oa_slot.ps1 passes -ServerSha256. No other branch's server.js, no deployment.
3 3w: after the first frame (and 3s), 30 s with NO input: the same viewer and connection (same_viewer: scene, status,
  pick, the host's session end / new client) and the picture going on (video_debug out grows). A break ends the watch
  at once and the arm with it (no 4, nothing after). OA_OBSERVE_SEC below 30 is refused outside the stub test.
4 every FAIL is followed by a READ-ONLY record: ui dump (a password field's text never written, the fixture password
  masked), screenshot, the app and host logs as they are; the exception path too.
5 a failed step ends the arm: 5 and 6a now too (4 and 3w as above); arm P: no keyboard up before either manual
  connect (2k / 6k), never put away there.

Tests (stub, no device): oa_pick_test 53/53 (new: 2s control + norow / offscreen -> INVALID with no Off tap, nolog /
  noselect -> FAIL; 3s control + weak-fallback / sharpen_start -> FAIL; 3w control (no input) + a break -> FAIL at once
  with the error text in the record + frozen picture -> FAIL + a short watch outside the stub -> INVALID; the sign-in
  record writes no password; P keyboard shown -> FAIL with nothing sent; the whole arm S flow through 2s / 3s / 3w; a
  break in the watch -> no tap on the picture at all, 4-7 NOT RUN; an unusable Settings control -> exit 2, nothing
  picked). oa_orchestration_test + 4 relay-trace cases (pinned + announced -> runs; silent (53fced4 as it is) / no pin /
  wrong pin -> no host, no AVD). pmclear 12/12, redact 7/7. No real run.
